    // The staircase function quantizing to the nearest tread of `steps` per unit,
    // halves going up. Precondition: steps is positive.
    StaircaseRound(x: Number, steps: Integer): Number
        => (x * steps.ToNumber).RoundedToNearest / steps.ToNumber;
